The names on this list split into two very different earnings stories. PLTR and AMD are reporting into a market that has already priced in strong AI demand — so the bar isn't "did they beat?", it's "did they beat by enough to justify where they're trading?" SNDK and WDC are the opposite: memory names where the cycle has already run hard, so guidance and pricing commentary matter more than the print itself. Same earnings week, two completely different questions to ask.
